batch.scope: Design-system catalog shell (sidebar, hash navigation, group collapse, toast) + Foundations level
batch.reason: normalize-design-export.md asks for one template or a small explicit batch per invocation; the DS has 33 states and 7 runtime components.

source.listData: Read from the original rendered in headless Chrome (after its runtime filled the sc-for lists and resolved live token values), not re-derived from the DCLogic literals.

pendingStates.behaviourInThisBatch: Sidebar and overview links to these states are kept (marked data-ds-pending) and fall back to #overview, the same fallback the export uses for unknown ids.

assets.note: Outfit 100-900 variable, latin-ext unicode-range (loaded only when such glyphs appear)

productTokens.source: export token sheet (abecq-tokens.css), copied verbatim into the DESIGN TOKENS section

catalogChrome.note: Viewer-only colours with no product token; declared as --ds-* so they are not mistaken for product tokens.

tokens.literalToToken: Literal values in the source chrome were replaced by --abq-* tokens only where the token value is identical (e.g. #001629 -> --abq-color-ink-900, clamp(26px,3.4vw,40px) -> --abq-font-h2).

runtimeConversions.to: static markup generated once from the rendered original

runtimeConversions.from: {{ }} bindings incl. live tv() token reads
runtimeConversions.to: static text equal to the rendered values; visual values reference tokens via per-element custom properties (--swatch, --type-size, --bar-width, --radius, --shadow, --weight)
hidden attribute on sections + aria-current="page" on the active link
data-copy / data-copy-label buttons + .ds-toast live region (hidden when empty), 1400 ms
removed; images and fonts use direct relative paths

animations.effect: html scroll-behavior: smooth; scroll to top on navigation
defined globally in the export, not used by any in-scope state
animations.status: deferred to the batch that contains its user
not added (no source behaviour to preserve)

deviations: Swatch internals are <span> instead of <div> (a <button> may only contain phrasing content); rendering is pixel-identical.

Decorative overview illustrations, swatch chips, spacing bars and radius/shadow previews are aria-hidden; icon SVGs are aria-hidden + focusable=false.
Organisms illustration: the push to the right moved from margin-left:auto on the first link to margin-right:auto on the logo (identical layout).
On load the page is scrolled back to the top, because the hash selects a page rather than a scroll target. The export behaves this way implicitly, since its content renders after the fragment jump.
Clipboard failure is swallowed (.catch) to avoid an unhandled rejection; the toast still shows, as in the export.

validation.staticGates: pass: no {{ }}, sc-*, x-dc, helmet, dc-import, style-hover, DCLogic, React, blob:, data:, UUID or support.js; all local references resolve; 1 <style> in head, 1 <script> before </body>; no inline handlers; inline style attributes (161) carry only custom properties
validation.domGates: pass: unique ids, every img has alt, every button has type, single h1, no heading-level skips, all --abq-*/--ds-* and per-element custom properties resolve

pixelComparison.method: headless Chrome 1x full-page screenshots, original export vs normalized, per state; per-channel threshold 24
pixelComparison.result: 30 of 30 captures have identical page dimensions; 20 are pixel-identical; radius and icons differ by 0.005-0.023% of pixels (glyph anti-aliasing in multi-part labels, no layout change)

validation.interactionParity: same as export: initial state, nav click (state, active link, hash via replaceState, no history entry, scroll to top), overview card click, group collapse/expand (chevron rotation), nav hover/active styles, swatch hover, copy + toast text/position/style/1400 ms dismissal, card hover (shadow/transform/colour), keyboard Enter on links, Space on summary, no console errors. Only expected difference: pending links fall back to overview.
notTested: real clipboard write (stubbed in the harness)

sourceAnomaliesPreserved: At 390px the Spacing state overflows horizontally to 476px (fixed 120/56/72px columns + 160px bar); identical in the export.
Below 960px the sidebar is hidden and the export offers no other navigation except the overview cards.
